comparison.objective: Separate the halves of a side-release buckle.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneously depress two sprung tabs while restraining the light halves and pulling them apart.
comparison.success_condition: Both tabs actuated and the male tongue fully withdrawn; falling off the table fails.
comparison.reason: Tests concurrent latch release and extraction, with no adjustable setting, threaded countertorque, or retained-cycle outcome.
